title: Cut Nyak Dhien
summary: Cut Nyak Dhien, born in Aceh Besar in 1848 (one source says 1850), married the Acehnese leader Teuku Umar in 1880 and fought the Dutch in Aceh by guerrilla warfare. After Umar fell in 1899 she continued the resistance until the Dutch captured her in 1901. She was exiled to Sumedang, West Java, where she died on 6 November 1908. Indonesia named her a national hero in 1964.

uncertainty.note: Birth: 1848 (De Appel Archive), 1850 (Lhokseumawe city government page). Hero title: 1964 (Lhokseumawe); the Jember page gives a date in 1962 against the decree year 1964 and does not resolve this.

importance.justification: Three sources describe her as a long-time guerrilla leader against the Dutch in the Aceh War, exiled to Sumedang and named a national hero of Indonesia.
